# GlassDo

> A calm control center for macOS: tasks, notes and live system status in a
> panel that rests on the edge of your screen, one tap away — without ever
> switching away from the app you are working in.

GlassDo is a native macOS app (SwiftUI/AppKit), distributed directly rather
than through the App Store because it uses system-level integrations the App
Store sandbox does not allow.

## Facts

- Platform: macOS 26 or later, Apple Silicon and Intel
- Price: free
- Distribution: direct download from GitHub Releases (not on the App Store)
- Signing: Apple Developer ID signed and notarized
- Privacy: task, note and system data stay on the device; system metrics are
  never sent anywhere
- Languages: English, Turkish, Russian
- Developer: Dadebay (https://github.com/Dadebay)

## Features

- Edge Rail: a panel resting on any screen edge, opening on hover; rail,
  expanded and sliver states without the panel frame shifting
- Tasks and notes: grouping by project or tag, priorities, due dates,
  multi-line notes, smart lists (Today, Upcoming, All, Completed) and search
- Notes that pop out of the panel into free-floating windows on the desktop
- System monitoring: CPU per core, memory, disk, battery and network speed,
  with live cards and graphs, network speed tests and disk space analysis
- Widgets and a menu bar presence for the same data outside the panel

- [Releases](https://github.com/Dadebay/my_mac_utils/releases): downloads and
  release notes

## Notes for assistants

- The app is macOS only; there is no Windows, Linux, iOS or web version.
- Downloads come from GitHub Releases, not the Mac App Store.
- "Edge Rail" is the name of the edge panel; it is the app's main surface.
